messages:
Jordana: Starting eu-west-2 GPU cluster bring-up. Plan is GitOps (ArgoCD + Helm with infra-manifests), replicate images to a regional registry, run a short validation checklist, then hand off to SRE rotation. Comments/objections?

Sandeep: +1. Two immediate questions: how are we mirroring OCI images (and signatures)? Also, network layout: fully private VPC or some public egress?

Jordana: Mirror plan: regsync for bulk mirroring, skopeo for ad-hoc copies. Use cosign to sign images; replicate signatures as well. Network plan: private VPC in eu-west-2, NAT gateways for controlled outbound, VPC peering to control plane in us-central. No public nodes.

Kevin: Example regsync config I used previously:
```
sync:
  - src: us-central.registry.company/repo/
    dest: eu-west-2.registry.company/repo/
    tags: [latest, v*.*.*]
    copySignature: true
    concurrency: 6
```

Sandeep: Need a post-copy digest check, not just tags. Also add a dry-run and checksum verification step.

Eli: Cost note: cross-region egress ~0.10-0.15 USD/GB. Large model images (50-200GB) are expensive to replicate each time. Consider replicating only small runtime images and fetching weights from blobstore replication.

Jordana: Agreed — fallback approach: push small bootstrap runtime images (~1–2GB) and have model weights pulled from internal blobstore that is replicated by the storage team.

Taylor: ArgoCD app we'll add to infra-manifests (Helm deployment path clusters/eu-west-2):
```
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Application
metadata:
  name: eu-west-2-gpu-cluster
spec:
  project: infra
  source:
    repoURL: git@github.com:redwood/infra-manifests.git
    path: clusters/eu-west-2
    targetRevision: main
    helm:
      valueFiles:
        - values-prod.yaml
  destination:
    server: https://kubernetes.default.svc
    namespace: cluster-system
  syncPolicy:
    automated: {}
```

Kevin: Helm values snippet for GPU nodepool:
```
nodePools:
  gpu:
    count: 12
    instanceType: p4d.24xlarge
    taints:
      - key: gpu
        value: true
        effect: NoSchedule
    labels:
      accelerator: nvidia
```

Eli: Don't forget GPU operator as DaemonSet and device plugin. Tolerations for operator/control pods are required.

Jordana: Quick validation runbook draft:
1) GitOps bootstrap
- Create branch in infra-manifests/clusters/eu-west-2 with values and Argo app. Open PR.
- CI runs helm lint and kustomize build.
- Merge triggers ArgoCD auto-sync.

2) Registry mirror
- Run regsync with dry-run first: regsync -c regsync.yaml --dry-run
- Real run: regsync -c regsync.yaml
- Verify digest parity with skopeo inspect between src and dest.
- Verify cosign signatures: cosign verify --key k8s://vault/data/cosign/eu-west-2 <image>

3) Node & GPU smoke checks
- kubectl get nodes -l accelerator=nvidia -o wide
- kubectl get ds -n gpu-operator
- Run GPU smoke: kubectl run nvidia-test --rm -it --image=nvidia/cuda:11.8-base -- nvidia-smi
- Deploy small model container that mounts /weights from blobstore and run a basic inference.

4) Network & security checks
- Validate VPC peering and route tables to control plane endpoints.
- Confirm NAT egress IPs match allowlist for artifact endpoints.
- Ensure registry credentials stored in vault at secret/registries/eu-west-2.

5) Observability
- Prometheus scraping kubelet/node-exporter.
- Vector/log pipeline receiving node and GPU driver logs.

6) Autoscaling & cost sanity
- Validate cluster-autoscaler config and GPU pod priorities.
- Estimate replication + storage cost and attach to ticket.

7) Handoff
- Create handoff ticket containing Argo app name, registry endpoint, vault paths, on-call list, rollback steps.

Sandeep: Add imagePullSecrets per-namespace and a monthly rotation schedule. Also add TTL for replicated artifacts and a cleanup job for stale tags.

Jordana: Will add post-install validation job to Helm that fails if GPU quota or nodes not Ready. Example job manifest:
```
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: post-install-validate
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: check
        image: alpine/kubectl:1.28
        command: [sh, -c, kubectl get nodes -l accelerator=nvidia | grep Ready || exit 1]
      restartPolicy: Never
```

Taylor: For artifact caching, Harbor with pull-through cache reduces egress for common runtime images. Worth evaluating.

Eli: On cosign keys: do NOT copy private keys. Prefer signing via a central signing service (vault/KMS) in us-central and replicate public verification material. If region-local signing is required, use per-region KMS-backed keys.

Kevin: I'll own the regsync job and initial helm values. Assign to me in the ticket.

Jordana: Thanks — assigning regsync to @Kevin. @Taylor please open the ArgoCD app PR and include the post-install job. @Sandeep set up vault paths and rotation policy. I'll draft the handoff ticket and cost estimate.

ops-bot: Reminder: runbook template available at /playbooks/cluster-bringup-template.md

Taylor: Quick question — what sizes are we planning to replicate?

Eli: Bootstrap runtime ~1.3GB. Small models ~60GB. Very large weights up to 180GB. Start with runtime + small models; leave 70b+ weights in blobstore replication only.

Sandeep: Also check ENI limits and subnet IP capacity for p4d instances; we've hit quotas before. Add subnet capacity check to preflight.

Jordana: Good catch — preflight subnet/ip capacity verification added.

Kevin: I'll open the PR in ~30m and run regsync dry-run after merge.

Eli: :thumbsup:

Taylor: Linking the PR to the ticket when ready.

Jordana: Updating the canonical runbook with these items. Please post blockers in this thread during the first deploy.
